## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy characterized by a big, round fat face and little blue eyes. His appearance is also defined by his prominent, objectionable ears that stick out like flaps.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon is a very serious young man. He is motivated by his goal to become a minister.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P41](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0041)_

## History

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson was a peer of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who studied alongside her in the advanced Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination class and fought [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) after asserting that [Anne](../character/anne.md) put on airs regarding her recitations. After completing his time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), he went on to teach school. His ultimate goal of becoming a minister remained a core ambition as he pursued his education and eventual career.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P4](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P7](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P8](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P12](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md)

Moody Spurgeon and [Anne](../character/anne.md) are schoolmates who share a bond built on their mutual academic pursuits. They discuss their fears regarding upcoming examinations and offer each other encouragement as they prepare for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) tests. Along with their fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students, they support one another while adjusting to their new educational environment in town.

- Friend of — schoolmates who discuss their examination fears and encourage each other  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P20](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0020)</sub>
